<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—M+1 ≈14 % of the base peak and a much smaller M+2 (~1 %)—the dominant contributor is carbon (13C ≈1.1 % per carbon). No significant M+2 intensity characteristic of sulfur, chlorine, or bromine is present, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
